limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
implementation: Two-state Moore FSM; positive-edge clock, asynchronous active-high reset to walking left; bumps ahead switch direction including simultaneous bumps.
testbench_coverage: All bump combinations from both states, sustained simultaneous bumps, irrelevant bumps, no-bump holds, input changes between edges, asynchronous reset from walking right, and reset dominance at a clock edge.
